text:
Ashley: FYI — eu-west-1 p4d Savings Plan term ends in ~37 days. Coverage currently ~78% across dedicated pools. Need a renewal plan + fallback ladder if we don't renew full amount.

billing-bot: Alert: SavingsPlan expiring (id: sp-0a1b2c). Current utilization 78%, coverage delta -12% q/q. Estimate monthly uncovered: ~9k GPU-hours.

Sam P: Do we have granular tag mapping? Last audit showed a bunch of orphaned prod-gpu-* tags.

Katie: I can run a utilization rollup by team. Quick question — are we targeting 100% coverage or keep ~80–85% and rely on spot/elastic burst for peaks?

Mike: Prefer ~85% commit, keep burst on spot for unpredictable spikes. 100% would bump monthly spend ~+28% on p4d footprint.

Ashley: Agreed. Can we model 85% commit for 1yr convertible vs 3yr all-upfront? Need delta and flexibility for region swap options.

Sam P: I'll extract last 6mo usage and run sensitivity. Quick CLI I use to validate coverage: ```aws ce get-reservation-coverage --time-period Start=2025-03-01,End=2025-03-31 --filter Dimensions=REGION,Values=eu-west-1```

Katie: If we drop to ~80% in eu-west we could shift ~30% of steady jobs to eu-central where we have some spare reserved capacity; cross-region routing is supported in our stack but adds ~5–8ms to end-to-end for model calls.

Mike: That latency is fine for batch training and evals but not for realtime chat endpoints. We should keep low-latency endpoints local and route large batches to central.

Ashley: Action items: Sam — run utilization + orphan tag cleanup by EOD Thu. Katie — produce cost delta table (1yr vs 3yr) for partial 85% coverage. Mike — propose routing policy updates for batch vs realtime. I'll prep renewal options to present to finance.

Sam P: On it. Also flag: AWS exchange window opens in ~2 weeks — could allow instance size conversion if demand profile shifts.

Katie: Draft numbers quick note: 1yr convertible @85% yields ~21% savings vs ondemand; 3yr upfront @85% ~34% savings but reduces flexibility. I'll attach a spreadsheet to this thread.

Mike: :thumbsup: If numbers line up, I prefer 1yr convertible as default for flexibility.

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: renewal window for sp-0a1b2c in 14 days. Reply 'ack' to snooze.

Ashley: ack — tagging @finance to confirm budget/approval path.

Katie: Also adding a quick sensitivity to spot price variability; can share by tomorrow.

Sam P: Will include per-team breakouts and orphan tag remediation plan.

Ashley: Good. Let's reconvene after numbers are in, target decision by next Tue.
